title: Charge the right shipping tier

blocks.text: A carrier charges by weight tier: each tier starts at a weight in grams and covers every parcel up to the start of the next one. `ShippingFees` holds the table, and two methods are missing. Finance found parcels charged a tier too low, and the rate-change report has been leaving out tiers.

items: `feeFor(grams)`: the fee of the tier the parcel falls into; a parcel lighter than every tier is refused with `IllegalArgumentException`;
`tierStartsBetween(fromGrams, toGrams)`: the tier starts from `fromGrams` to `toGrams`, both included, lightest first.

blocks.text: When you're done, every weight, including one exactly at a tier's start, is charged its own tier, and the report lists every tier start in the range, including one at either end. About four lines in total.

cases.says: a parcel between two tier starts pays the lower tier, and a range strictly around tier starts lists them lightest first
a parcel whose weight is exactly a tier's start pays that tier, not the one below
a weight below the first tier is refused with IllegalArgumentException
a tier starting exactly at the range's upper end is included
